subject: math
description: Explore how cutting a circle into sectors and rearranging them helps estimate and explain the area formula.
learningObjectives: Cut a circle into equal sectors and describe how rearranging them forms a nearly rectangular shape
Connect the rearranged sector model to the measurements half the circumference and radius
Explain why the area of a circle is estimated by A = pi r squared
Use radius and diameter correctly when reasoning about circle area
Describe how increasing the number of sectors improves the area estimate
prerequisites: Identify radius and diameter of a circle
Understand circumference as the distance around a circle
Find the area of a rectangle using length times width
Recognize pi as the ratio related to circle circumference
